Rhea N.: hey everyone — Rhea here, starting today on ML infra. i brought a tiny jar of my sourdough starter and my uke for luck. i'll be by the pantry around 10:15 if anyone wants a slice of starter-fed toast (vegan spread in the green tub) 🎸🍞
Ethan S.: welcome Rhea! will swing by at 10:20. jam or tahini? (important breakfast decisions) 😄
Jun Park: jam for me but curious about the starter — teach me later? i have a terrible track record with proofing 🤦‍♂️
Priya V.: heads up: new hire orientation at 14:00 in conf C. (automated)
DevBot: Reminder: Badge pickup at reception before entering secure floors. (automated)
Sara L.: welcome! i'm on ops — if you need GPU queue or repo access ping me and i'll open it. also i have a little ukulele songbook if you want it 🎶
Ethan S.: poll: react :strawberry: for jam, :seedling: for tahini. or reply if you have a weird schmear preference.
Rhea N.: jam seems popular — saved a jar of cherry jam and a jar of tahini just in case. labeled everything and left notes for allergies. i'll also demo a 2-min sourdough refresh later for anyone who wants to learn.
Jun Park: i'll take the demo! and i may raid the songbook later — welcome aboard Rhea :wave:
Priya V.: welcome Rhea — rooftop quick intro at 12:30 if you want to meet the product folks. see you soon!
Rhea N.: thanks everyone! excited to be here, see you in the pantry 🍞🎶
